nodes.title: Studio browser
nodes.subtitle: Supabase client session
nodes.description: Google sign-in is mediated by Supabase Auth. The browser SDK manages user sessions.
nodes.note: Illustrative identity and requests; no sign-in is performed here.
nodes.narration: Google sign-in is mediated by Supabase Auth. The browser SDK manages user sessions.

nodes.title: Supabase Auth
nodes.subtitle: Identity provider
nodes.description: Return a user access token after sign-in. Backend stores no user access tokens or custom login sessions.
nodes.narration: Return a user access token after sign-in. Backend stores no user access tokens or custom login sessions.

nodes.title: API request
nodes.subtitle: Browser → FastAPI
nodes.description: Send the Supabase access token in the Authorization header, including authenticated fetch-based SSE.
nodes.narration: Send the Supabase access token in the Authorization header, including authenticated fetch-based SSE.

nodes.title: Verify user token
nodes.subtitle: FastAPI · Supabase adapter
nodes.description: SDK get_claims verifies signature and expiry; adapter checks issuer, audience, role and user ID.
nodes.note: SDK caches asymmetric keys; legacy symmetric tokens use Auth-server validation. Provider outages/configuration failures return 503.
nodes.narration: SDK get_claims verifies signature and expiry; adapter checks issuer, audience, role and user ID.

nodes.title: 401 · Sign in
nodes.subtitle: Invalid / expired token
nodes.description: Reject missing, forged, wrong-project or expired user tokens.
nodes.note: An open SSE stream periodically checks expiry and closes with session_expired. Logout does not instantly invalidate an issued token.
nodes.narration: Reject missing, forged, wrong-project or expired user tokens.

nodes.title: Check job owner
nodes.subtitle: FastAPI → repository
nodes.description: Use the verified identity to scope job queries. A browser-supplied owner ID is never trusted.
nodes.note: The direct postgres connection does not automatically apply per-user RLS; application ownership checks remain necessary.
nodes.narration: Use the verified identity to scope job queries. A browser-supplied owner ID is never trusted.

nodes.title: 404 · Unavailable
nodes.subtitle: Missing or another owner
nodes.description: Return the same not-found response for absent jobs and jobs owned by somebody else.
nodes.narration: Return the same not-found response for absent jobs and jobs owned by somebody else.

nodes.title: Own job access
nodes.subtitle: Status · result · events · retry
nodes.description: Return only owned records. Ownership also protects stream replay and user mutations.
nodes.narration: Return only owned records. Ownership also protects stream replay and user mutations.

nodes.title: Cloud Tasks
nodes.subtitle: Processing caller
nodes.description: Cloud Tasks attaches a Google OIDC identity token for the configured task service account.
nodes.narration: Cloud Tasks attaches a Google OIDC identity token for the configured task service account.

nodes.title: Cloud Scheduler
nodes.subtitle: Maintenance caller
nodes.description: Scheduler attaches a Google identity token for a separate maintenance service account.
nodes.narration: Scheduler attaches a Google identity token for a separate maintenance service account.

nodes.title: Verify Google token
nodes.subtitle: FastAPI · internal guard
nodes.description: Verify Google signature, issuer, expiry, audience and verified email. Cloud Run transport is public; the application enforces route-level authentication.
nodes.note: Supabase user tokens and task headers alone cannot authorize internal endpoints.
nodes.narration: Verify Google signature, issuer, expiry, audience and verified email. Cloud Run transport is public; the application enforces route-level authentication.

nodes.title: Match allowed caller
nodes.subtitle: Processing / maintenance
nodes.description: Require the exact caller email configured for the requested route. Processing and maintenance use different identities.
nodes.narration: Require the exact caller email configured for the requested route. Processing and maintenance use different identities.

nodes.title: Run internal handler
nodes.subtitle: Cloud Run · same backend
nodes.description: Run the job processor or maintenance only after the route-specific identity checks pass.
nodes.narration: Run the job processor or maintenance only after the route-specific identity checks pass.

nodes.title: 403 · Wrong caller
nodes.subtitle: Valid token · disallowed identity
nodes.description: A valid Google identity is insufficient if its email does not match this route.
nodes.note: Missing/invalid service tokens return 401; unavailable verifier/configuration returns 503.
nodes.narration: A valid Google identity is insufficient if its email does not match this route.
